I thought I understood, but once again,
I was reminded of the sheer depth of her love for manga.

Seeing Kiseki looking so earnest, something clicked. Come to think of it,
the same sort of thing happened when she was drawing her battle manga—

Auuugh! Yes, this is it! So intense! A bond that goes beyond friendship!
I knew that's where the real heat of this genre comes from!

...Hmm, no, that's not it...
It needs more of that aura of a powerhouse... a punchier delivery...

"...Like we're gonna sit back while you disrespect our crew.
Let's show these chumps what we're made of! Full charge!!"

One day. I spotted Kiseki behind the school building,
holding her smartphone.

Whoaaa! I knew about long-cut and short-cut jackets,
but semi-shorts exist too?! The historical background is so fascinating!

No, !! Take turns, everyone has to take turns!
Wait your turn, pleaseee!

Could Kiseki have gotten too close to actual delinquents!?
—I rushed over to them in a panic, raising my voice.

............Huh?
Trainer?

...Yeah. Let's buy a few for reference!
So, do you have that long-cut gakuran... and baggy bontans?
Because that's the exact kind of manga I want to draw, too!!

When I listen back to them later, so often I'm like,
'...Yeah, totally unusable!' It's a mystery, a complete mystery!

Could you tell me more?
Next, about the rivalries with other teams!

A burning desire to make the reader say, 'This is awesome, no doubt.'
...That's why I can't compromise, not even a fraction. Because—
Because I want every single person who reads it to say it's awesome!

...Ah! Sorry, Trainer!
I just thought of a great line, so I was recording a voice memo!

I've read tons of manga up until now!
And among them, the works that truly stayed in my heart all had 'spirit.'

Aah! Leave it to me!
I'm an honorary member of the Scorpions too!

"Hah, look who's getting cocky... You better be ready to pay the price...?
—Taste my brass knuckles!"

Still... I wonder why?
When inspiration strikes, I always think, 'Am I a genius or what?!'

Underlying this story were 'realistic details,'
all born from Kiseki's earnest, firsthand research.

Oh, right! Would you like to read it too, Trainer?
Completed with everyone's help—'Regards, Outsider'!

Yeah, pretty much. ...Though having you put it into words
like that makes me kinda embarrassed...
Yes! Isn't that obvious?!

"Oi. Did you really draw this?" "Hah? Don't bullcrap me!"
"Never mind that, hand it over! It's my turn, damn it!"

Hey! Those Rampage Racing punks just barged in
to mess up our turf! Unforgivable... We settle this in a race! Kiseki, you're in too!

I see! So your bond is less like simple friends,
and more like family! Almost like true kin!

It was right around then... At the freestyle racetrack,
Kiseki was completely surrounded by a rough-looking crowd!

A few days later. At a clothing store carrying student uniforms,
I spotted Kiseki talking with a clerk. As I watched—

"Bloom, scatter, heavenly ring. Carve the one, transcend the zero.
Here—I engrave the genesis. 'Hexa-Petal Izayoi'!!"

It was a story about a protagonist who had nowhere to belong at school,
finding a true "home" in the everyday life with delinquent comrades—

In short, her words from earlier were dialogue for her manga.
Wondering what kind of work her new project would be, I left the scene.

Hell yeaaah! We did itttt!
...Ehehe!

Ahaha! Nobody's in any danger at all!
They're just taking turns reading my manga on my tablet!
